title: Myocardial Ischemia Reperfusion Protocol in Mice
author: Lin Zhong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6xfhfjn
materials: Mice are anesthetized with pentobarbital (50 mg.kg, IP).

steps.title: Prepare the surgical site
steps.instruction: Shave and disinfect the ventral neck and left parasternal region.

substeps.instruction: Apply Betadine to the area
Follow with 70% alcohol

steps.title: Perform endotracheal intubation
steps.instruction: Establish mechanical ventilation for the mouse.

substeps.instruction: Position the mouse supine on a heating pad
Make a small incision through the skin underlying the trachea
Expose the trachea and make a small puncture
Perform intubation using a PE-50 tube
Connect the tube to a small rodent ventilator (Harvard Apparatus)

steps.title: Install ECG monitoring
steps.instruction: Place ECG electrode leads subcutaneously to monitor the ECG during myocardial infarction (MI).

steps.title: Perform left thoracotomy
steps.instruction: Access the chest cavity using a surgical microscope.

substeps.instruction: Perform a left thoracotomy
Enter the fourth intercostal space using scissors and blunt dissection

steps.title: Induce myocardial ischemia
steps.instruction: Ligate the left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery.

substeps.instruction: Place an 8-0 silk suture through the myocardium into the anterolateral left ventricular wall around the LAD
Place a sterile PE-50 tube against the LAD
Tie the suture against the tube to ligate the LAD
Cover the surgical area with sterile gauze soaked in warm saline during the ischemic period

steps.title: Perform reperfusion
steps.instruction: Restore blood flow to the LAD.

substeps.instruction: Remove the PE-50 tube
Cut the LAD ligature

steps.title: Close the chest cavity
steps.instruction: Close the chest in layers using 7-0 sutures.

steps.title: Wean from ventilation and close incisions
steps.instruction: Transition the mouse to spontaneous respiration and close all surgical sites.

substeps.instruction: Gradually wean the mouse from the ventilator to resolve any possible pneumothorax
Remove the endotracheal tube once spontaneous respiration resumes
Close the trachea incision with 8-0 suture
Close the skin with 6-0 suture

steps.title: Post-operative care
steps.instruction: Ensure recovery from anesthesia and provide analgesia.

substeps.instruction: Maintain the mouse on the heating pad until fully recovered from anesthesia
Administer Buprenorphine SC immediately following surgery and every 8-12 hr for 72 hr
